UniverseName: Chronicles of Aetheria: The Infinite Age

Options.Value: a jagged wyvern claw-mark across the left pauldron
a pale sabre scar splitting the brow
a silver-plated replacement gauntlet forged after a siege
scorched lightning-veins along the sword arm

Upbringing.Value: the mud-slick alleys of the Outer Rim
the floating glass towers of the Spire Collegium
a mossy hedge-mage cottage on the frontier
a quiet monastic scriptorium buried in snow
a disowned noble estate with a locked library

Arcane Quirk: silver sparks leaping off their fingertips whenever a storm gathers
ink-stained cuffs and a habit of muttering equations in dead languages
eyes that briefly turn milky white while reading ambient mana
a refusal to sleep under iron roofs because it dulls the aether
candles dimming or flaring to match every sudden shift in mood
pocketed chalk stubs used to sketch protective wards on tavern tables

Rift Origin: the lightless trenches of the Great Rift
a cracked astral seal beneath the Sunken Sea
the fever-dreams of a forgotten fallen titan
an inverted black spire between the stars
a bleeding scar where two ley-lines snapped
a sealed plague-well beneath the Old Empire

Physical Mutation.Value: a Crown of a Thousand Eyes

Feeding Behavior: draining ambient aether until nearby enchantments turn to ash
harvesting the waking memories of stranded travelers
devouring iron ore and raw magic crystals by the wagonload
luring patrols into fog banks with mimicked cries for help
slowly rotting crops and livestock for leagues around its lair
stalking lone spellcasters drawn to ley-line convergences

Options.Value: Shadows Detach and Whisper in Reverse
Open Flames Freeze Into Black Ice
Time Stutters Backwards Every Seventh Heartbeat

Calling Card: a clipped silver coin balanced upright on an empty strongbox
a single black raven feather pinned to the window latch
a polite chalk thank-you note signed with a fake noble seal
a melted stub of green tallow candle left on the doorstep
an unlocked front door with every trap neatly disarmed
no trace at all save a missing portrait and an open skylight

Oath of the Wild: never permitting cold iron to scar the heart-trees of their grove
hunting down every rift-born beast that strays across the treeline
guiding lost travelers safely through the winter passes for no coin
taking only what the forest offers and never felling living timber
keeping the ancient stone cairns intact against encroaching lords
answering the call whenever the border-beacons are lit

Workshop Quirk: three pairs of magnifying lenses stacked permanently on their forehead
singed eyebrows from refusing to test new fuel mixtures outdoors
a habit of tapping every stone wall to judge its load-bearing integrity
blueprints scribbled across the backs of unpaid guild invoices
a fierce rivalry with pure wizards who refuse to document their formulas
pockets that clink loudly with spare brass gears and copper wire

Sacred Order.Value: the Order of the Golden Dawn
the Keepers of the Silver Moon
the Wardens of the Quiet Hearth
the Pilgrims of the Endless Road

Sacred Vow: never turning away the wounded regardless of banner or creed
speaking no deliberate falsehood even under threat of execution
giving away every tenth coin earned to frontier orphanages
keeping a night-vigil whenever a crescent moon rises
destroying any abyssal corruption encountered on the road
carrying the last words of fallen soldiers back to their kin

Options.Value: Hands That Glow Faintly When Setting Broken Bone
A Voice That Silences Panic Across a Battlefield
Immunity to Mundane Rot and Fever
A Halo of Warm Gold That Wards Off Abyssal Cold
Relic Splinter in a Glass Locket

Lair Location: the smoking caldera of Mount Vael
a sunken crystal cavern beneath the Northern Fjord
a cloud-piercing spire above the Highland Passes
the ruined vaults of a long-dead Imperial capital
a glacial rift fortress locked in eternal winter
a subterranean aether-well pulsing with raw mana
Draconic Temperament: treating mortal kingdoms as entertaining chessboards to nudge once a century
demanding annual tributes of rare poetry and untouched silver
slumbering for decades until the clink of a thief's boot wakes the cavern
guarding an ancient rift-seal that mortals have long forgotten
collecting fallen war-banners from every army foolish enough to climb the peak
conversing politely with bold scholars before deciding whether to spare them

Options.Value: a broken runic spearhead still lodged beneath one collarbone
a tattered left wingtip scorched in a war with a rival wyrm
one milky blind eye that still senses raw aether flow
a melted crown fused permanently into the brow ridge
Petrified Eggs of a Lost Lineage

1_Heritage.Text: At {Age}, {Full} rose from the high courts of {Noble House}, sworn to the banners of the {Knightly Order} with {Renown} of renown and {Tournaments Won} on the lists.
Born into {Upbringing}, {Full} clawed an arcane education out of scraps and stolen parchment, now at {Age} wielding {Spells Mastered} of {Magic School}.
Shaped by {Upbringing}, the {Age}-year-old {Heroic Path} {Full} devoted decades to {Magic School}, mastering {Spells Mastered} despite an Arcane Instability of {Arcane Instability}.
{Full} crawled forth from {Rift Origin} some {Manifestation Age} ago, a creature rated {Rift Threat Rating} on the Imperial Rift Ledger with a {Sanity Toll} sanity toll.
At {Age} with {Heists Pulled} behind them and a {Crown Bounty} price on their head, {Full} works as a {Specialty} tied to {Guild Affiliation}.
After {Years in the Wilds} patrolling {Sacred Domain}, the {Age}-year-old {Full} walks the borderlands as a {Primal Aspect} sworn to the wild.
Trained within {Forge Guild} with {Masterworks Forged} stamped with {Possessive} mark, the {Age}-year-old {Full} specializes in {Craft Discipline} on a {Workshop Budget} bench budget.
Having walked {Pilgrimages Completed} for {Sacred Order}, the {Age}-year-old {Full} serves the realm as a devoted {Divine Calling}.
Spanning {Wingspan} from wingtip to wingtip after {Age} of reign, {Full} — a wyrm of {Scale Lineage} — rules from {Lair Location} over a hoard worth {Hoard Value}.

2_Craft_and_Arms.Text: Clad in {Armor Suite} and wielding {Signature Weapon}, {Subject} never rode into battle without {Warband Kit}.
Channeling aether through {Focus Tool}, {Subject} favored {Signature Spells}, marked always by {Arcane Quirk}.
Armored in {Physical Mutation} and striking with {Natural Weapon}, the horror manifested {Eldritch Manifestations} while {Feeding Behavior}.
Armed with {Signature Weapon} and packing {Thief's Pack}, {Nick} left behind {Calling Card} after every clean score.
Carrying {Warden Weapon} alongside {Forager's Satchel}, {Subject} kept a fierce oath of {Oath of the Wild}.
Never seen without {Signature Contraption} and {Toolbelt & Parts}, {Nick} stood out in every tavern for {Workshop Quirk}.
Bearing {Holy Implement} and {Sacred Vestments}, {Subject} lived strictly by a vow of {Sacred Vow}.
Capable of unleashing {Breath Weapon}, the ancient wyrm guarded {Hoard Treasures} while {Draconic Temperament}.

3_Bonds_and_Marks.Text: Riding into the fray atop {War Mount} and bearing {Battle Scar}, {Nick} became an unmistakable sight on the frontier.
Paired with {War Mount}, {Subject} could outride any border patrol in the highlands.
Still wearing {Battle Scar}, {Subject} carried the memory of past sieges into every new campaign.
Sworn to restore honor to {Noble House}, {Subject} kept {Possessive} {Signature Weapon} polished to a mirror sheen.
Accompanied everywhere by {Arcane Familiar}, {Subject} secretly guarded {Forbidden Grimoire} from rival archmages.
With {Arcane Familiar} perched close at hand, {Subject} rarely traveled any road truly alone.
Rumors persisted that {Nick} kept {Forbidden Grimoire} hidden behind layers of lethal wards.
Few looked upon {Possessive} {Focus Tool} without feeling the cold prickle of gathered aether.
Wherever it drifted, reality frayed — {Reality Distortion} — while fanatics of {Mortal Cult} chanted its name in hidden cellars.
Its mere passage warped the natural laws around it: {Reality Distortion}.
Deep in the border towns, whispered prayers from {Mortal Cult} still tried to draw it closer.
Even seasoned inquisitors refused to camp within three leagues of its spoor.
A prized {Shadow Relic} turned impossible jobs into quiet paydays, leaving city watch captains baffled.
Relying on nimble footwork and street contacts rather than rare magic, {Nick} stayed two alleys ahead of the watch.
Stalking the treeline beside {Beast Companion}, {Subject} needed no signal horn to coordinate an ambush.
Preferring solitude to the noise of walled towns, {Subject} read broken twigs and wind-shifts like open books.
Trailing close behind on clicking joints, {Mechanical Companion} served as both workbench assistant and tireless sentry.
Working solo by lamplight, {Subject} trusted tempered steel and clean geometry over fickle spells.
Touched by grace, {Nick} carried a rare sign of favor: {Divine Blessing}.
Through quiet discipline rather than flashy miracles, {Subject} earned deep trust across the border parishes.
The great beast still bore {Ancient Scar}, a grim warning to would-be dragonslayers.
Not a single mortal blade had ever left a lasting mark upon its armored hide.

4_Deeds_and_Flaws.Text: {Nick} once wrestled a mountain troll to the ground unarmed, earning a tavern song sung from the coast to the crags.
Scholars whispered that {Nick} could dissect a complex ward at a single glance, having memorized forbidden treatises in youth.
Arrows and winter fevers alike failed to slow {Nick}, who once marched three days through a blizzard with a shattered rib.
{Nick} could pluck a purse off a duke or thread an arrow through a visor slit before anyone noticed a hand move.
Kings and beggars alike paused to listen whenever {Nick} spoke, swayed by effortless presence and sharp wit.
Blunt and painfully direct, {Nick} had a talent for offending local magistrates within five minutes of entering any hall.
Hardly built for heavy lifting, {Nick} solved problems with timing and leverage rather than brute muscle.
An entire border garrison broke and fled before a single blow fell, undone purely by the terror radiating from its form.
Siege ballistae and holy fire shattered harmlessly against its hide, leaving only smoking craters in its wake.
With a breath hot enough to vitrify castle granite, the wyrm once reduced an invading armada to drifting ash.
Older than three dynasties, the wyrm outmaneuvered rival kings and archmages without ever leaving its mountain hall.
Travelers along the high roads knew {Nick} as a steady survivor who weathered every storm Aetheria threw down.
Ballads and watch-reports alike treated its name as an omen of darker seasons ahead.

5_Destiny.Text: Bound to a legendary relic of the Infinite Age, {Nick} will either mend the weakening ley-lines or shatter the balance forever.
Though the highland borders grow darker by the season, {Subject} stood ready to hold the line for {Noble House}.
The realm feared the raw aether crackling at {Possessive} fingertips, yet {Subject} pressed onward in pursuit of deeper truth.
Somewhere beneath the cracked crust of Aetheria, it waited patiently for the Rift to widen once more.
For the right purse — or the right grudge — {Nick} remained ready to vanish over the rooftops before dawn.
So long as the deep woods breathed, {Subject} would remain their silent shield against fire, axe, and rift.
With one eye on the forge and the other on the horizon, {Nick} swore that the next invention would change the age.
Carrying light into the darkest corners of the frontier, {Subject} walked on without asking for reward.
High above the passing empires of mortals, {Nick} watched the centuries turn like sparks rising from embers.
